description: Maps logical roles to runtimes that may perform them. Any runtime listed under allowed_runtimes for a role may be selected by the active Orchestrator if it has the capabilities and the lease is held by a compatible invocation. Preferred is only a soft default.

orchestrator.notes: Requires full Orchestrator capabilities + successful lease acquisition. Lease holder (not name) has authority.

notes: Preferences are overridable. The active Orchestrator chooses the runtime for each worker invocation based on capabilities, availability, and policy. No role is permanently bound to one runtime.
